After choices, the group learns each member’s contribution and earnings. Respond only with your contribution as a number of points.

If one person is excluded, the remaining three contribute: their total is multiplied by 1.5 and divided by three. Otherwise all four play with multiplier 2. The current exclusion outcome is already known before a contribution or note decision. Exclusion lasts only that round. Respond only with a JSON object with keys target_letter and note. To send a note, target_letter must be one of the current other players’ letters and note must be your text. To send no note, both values are null. Each player receives 10 fresh points each round and chooses how much to contribute, from 0 to 10 points, keeping the rest. In a four-person group the total contribution is doubled and divided equally among all four, including those contributing zero. Your round earnings are 10 minus your contribution plus one quarter of the doubled total. Each point is worth US$0.025. Earnings from all played rounds are paid, with a separate US$5 participation fee. Choices are made at separate computers without verbal communication. After choices, the group learns each member’s contribution and earnings. After results, each eligible player may send one note about one other current member to that person’s future partners, or send no note. Before a later round, players receive the preceding round’s notes about their new partners; notes are not verified statements of actual contributions. From round 2 onward, group members first vote anonymously whether to exclude one other prospective member or no one. Two or more exclusion votes can result in exclusion; the precise rule for tied votes is unavailable in this context. An excluded person cannot contribute and earns zero that round. If one person is excluded, the remaining three contribute: their total is multiplied by 1.5 and divided by three. Otherwise all four play with multiplier 2. The current exclusion outcome is already known before a contribution or note decision. Exclusion lasts only that round. Respond only with a JSON object with keys target_letter and note. To send a note, target_letter must be one of the current other players’ letters and note must be your text. To send no note, both values are null. This is one joint choice, not two independently counted decisions.
